name: SWE-Lancer
intro: SWE-Lancer 收录 1,488 个围绕 Expensify 代码库的真实 Upwork 软件工程任务，实际支付总额为 100 万美元。其中 764 个独立贡献者任务由模型生成代码补丁并接受隐藏 Playwright 端到端测试，724 个工程管理任务要求模型从至少两个候选方案中选择最佳方案；最终以 Pass@1、获得的总报酬和赚取率衡量经济价值。
build_method: Upwork 真实任务筛选、专业工程师复核、隐藏端到端测试
task_type: 代码生成, 补全, Agent任务
eval_feature: 真实经济价值、隐藏端到端测试、管理方案选择
scale: 1,488 个任务（IC 764、管理 724），真实报酬 100 万美元
build_method_en: Real Upwork Task Screening, Professional-Engineer Review, Hidden End-to-End Tests
eval_feature_en: Real Economic Value, Hidden End-to-End Tests, Management Proposal Selection
intro_en: SWE-Lancer contains 1,488 real Upwork software engineering tasks centered on the Expensify codebase, representing $1 million in actual payouts. For 764 individual-contributor tasks, models generate repository patches scored by hidden Playwright end-to-end tests; for 724 engineering-management tasks, models choose the best of at least two proposals. Economic performance is reported with Pass@1, total payout earned, and earn rate.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.12115 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C. The diagram preserves the 1,488-task, $1M Upwork source; human eligibility and clarity review; separate 764-task individual-contributor and 724-task management branches; hidden Playwright end-to-end tests with three-round fixed/broken validation; offline Docker execution; proposal-choice grading; and economic reporting. Pass@1 is the primary setting, while pass@k appears only as an ablation in the paper.
